title: Fight becomes apology
situation: A punch aimed at a stranger who turns out to be a friend. The fist stops short before contact, opens into a hand, and the hand is offered and taken. Recognition changes the target mid-strike without a snap.
success_observation: Cardboard cut-out skin applied to 3D Bolas motion bank joints.
ledger: cardboard cut-out pieces (cast/dummy/ bola, shim, dot)
